title: Towards Mechanistic Interpretability of Graph Transformers via Attention Graphs
authors: Batu El, Deepro Choudhury, Pietro Liò, Chaitanya K. Joshi
abstract: We treat the attention patterns of a graph transformer as graphs themselves and use this view to study how these models route information. The attention-graph perspective surfaces interpretable circuits and predicts where graph transformers under- and over-rely on structural priors.
